description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of two categories related to deployment efficiency within the Paper Copilot system. The chart is divided into two slices: a large orange slice labeled “60.9s (69.92%)” and a smaller blue slice labeled “Efficient deployment 26.2s (30.08%)”. The orange slice occupies the majority of the chart, accounting for nearly 70% of the total, while the blue slice represents the remaining 30%. The chart includes percentage labels directly inside each slice and a legend is not present; however, the blue slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded or offset from the rest of the pie. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the larger orange slice positioned prominently at the bottom left and the smaller blue slice at the top right.
